name: MOBI Industry Co.
summary: MOBI Industry Co. manufactures and sells fertilizers and nitrogen compounds in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also offers phosphate and potash fertilizers; plastics; household insect and rodenticides; floor, glass, and furniture polishes and scouring powders; and preparations for perfuming rooms and removing odors. The company also provides soaps and shampoos; industrial detergents, and washing and cleaning materials, as well as preparations under the Mobi and Shot brand names. In addition, it is involved in plastic bottles manufacturing. The company was formerly known as National Fertilizer Company Ltd. and changed its name to MOBI Industry Co. in November 2022.
